title: WindowsAudioSessionMute engages, mutes, and restores the process audio session
condition: WindowsAudioSessionMuteTests (tests/ViceSharp.TestHarness/Audio) verifies: when a render endpoint exists the fixture engages and the process Windows audio session reads muted (endpointExists equals IsEngaged, then muted is true); disposing an engaged fixture restores the prior mute state; and construction plus double-dispose never throw on any host. Validates TR-QA-TESTSILENCE-001.
